assessment.no_indicators_found_with_sufficient_cove: No indicators reported with recorded sufficient coverage

finding.artifact_unverified: This artifact hash is declared in the manifest. The manifest alone cannot verify the stored bytes.
finding.assessment_differences: The recorded comparison assessment reports observed differences between the supplied inputs. This does not establish which input was changed.
finding.assessment_manipulation: The recorded assessment indicates suspected manipulation. Heuristic indicators are not proof.
finding.assessment_missing: No assessment was recorded. Evidence sufficiency is unavailable.
finding.assessment_unusable: The recorded assessment cannot support a conclusion for this run.
finding.detector_unavailable: A recorded detector did not succeed or has no recorded execution. Its evidence is unavailable.
finding.input_unverified: This input hash identifies submitted evidence. The manifest alone cannot verify the stored bytes.
finding.outputs_uninterpreted: Additional plugin outputs are recorded but have no reviewed reporting adapter and are not interpreted here.
finding.run_limited: This pipeline outcome limits the available evidence; no favorable conclusion follows.

status.ABORTED: The pipeline stopped early. Evidence may be incomplete.
status.BLOCKED: Policy or dependencies prevented the selected pipeline from operating.
status.COMPLETED: The pipeline completed. Successful execution is not a forensic assessment.
status.INCOMPLETE: The pipeline finished with partial evidence; some planned work did not succeed.
status.NO_DETECTORS: No forensic detectors were installed and enabled for this run. No forensic conclusion is available.
